money-and-cost.cash_card_notes: The local coin currency is the Panama Balboa (PAB). The banknote currency is the US Dollar (USD). Beware of counterfeit currency, especially USD50 and USD100 notes. You can't exchange Australian dollars in Panama, but you can exchange US dollars. Credit cards are widely accepted. Carry cash if you're travelling to rural areas. Most international hotels and tourist facilities accept credit and debit cards. Ask your bank whether your ATM card will work in Panama.

laws.rule: Penalties for drug offences are severe. They include lengthy prison sentences in local jails. Authorities may arrest you for illegal drugs if you're either: carrying even a very small amount of drugs, or with someone who's using them If you're found driving under the influence of alcohol or other drugs, authorities will arrest and possibly detain you. Border officials may screen you for drugs, including on departure.

culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: It's illegal to photograph public buildings in Panama. If you are unsure about a site, ask an official before you take photos. Ask for permission before photographing anyone, especially women, children and Indigenous people. The Guna General Congress's rules for Guna Yala: no drones, no swimwear in village streets, and ask before photographing ceremonies or sacred sites. A visitor fee is charged at Nusagandi.

visa-preparation.entry_summary: No visa needed when arriving by air or land: an initial stay of 90 days is granted at the border (not guaranteed). Show the equivalent of USD 1,000 or a credit card and a return or onward ticket, and complete the online traveller declaration.
visa-preparation.fastest_entry: Visa-free entry by air or land, initial stay of 90 days.
visa-preparation.before_departure: Complete the online immigration and customs declaration, carry proof of USD 1,000 or a credit card and a return or onward ticket. Arrivals by boat other than cruise ships need a visa.
visa-preparation.useful_stay: Initial stay of 90 days, at the discretion of immigration authorities.

steps.step: Complete the online immigration and customs declaration (paper forms still accepted during the transition).
Show the equivalent of USD 1,000 or a credit card, and a return or onward ticket.
Make sure the passport is stamped on entry: leaving without the stamp can bring a fine of up to USD 1,000.
Pay the departure tax at Tocumen Airport if the airline ticket doesn't include it.
